purpose: Select generated-future examples for the public blog without choosing the most visually persuasive instance after semantic scoring.

known_when_fixed: all 80 Cosmos direct-language closed-loop binary outcomes
the excluded calibration and dry-run semantic results
the frozen semantic scorer and audit sample
not_known_when_fixed: any canonical, short, declarative, or contrastive confirmation semantic label

eligible_population: Every scored replan chunk from the 80 registered Cosmos direct-language episodes.

selection_rule.description: For each category, choose the first eligible chunk in the fixed lexicographic ordering below. If a category is absent, render an explicit no-observed-example panel.

required_annotations: executed relation at the matched action horizon
wording, direction, episode seed, and replan index
rendering.caption_boundary: These examples explain frozen aggregate labels. They are not additional independent trials and are never used to estimate a rate.
